question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: that

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the usage of the given words.
 
• "So" is used as subordinating conjunction to introduce clauses of result or decision.
 
 
• **Example -** *You are right, of course, **so **I think we will accept what the bank offers.*
 
 
 
• "Such" is used as a determiner before a noun phrase to add emphasis.
 
 
• ​**Example -** *We had **such **an awful meal at that restaurant!*
 
 
 
• "That" is a relative pronoun used to introduce defining relative clauses.
 
 
• **Example -** ​*The teacher suggested **that **we finish our homework.*
 
 
 
• **"This"** and "**these**" are used to point to something near you. For a singular thing, use **this**. For a plural thing, use **these**.
 
 
• **Example -** *I like **this **phone a lot.*
 
 
 
• *​*As per the usage of the given words** "that"*** *is an appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 3.

Complete Paragraph: *One day, my six-year-old sister (1) asked __us which career she should (2) __opt __for. My father suggested (3) **__that __**she should become a doctor, (4)______ my mother said she could (5)______ a newspaper reporter. I (6) ______ she would make a (7)______ teacher. After a brief (8)______ my sister declared, “I will become (9)______ actress. Then I will get an (10)______ to play all these roles.”*
